body:
Reading the DataDome challenge

The DataDome interstitial embeds a var dd = {...} object and loads its script from captcha-delivery.com. Detectors should look for the datadome cookie alongside these markers.
note: A blog that QUOTES the DataDome markers (captcha-delivery.com, 'var dd') in prose, but is NOT served by DataDome: no datadome cookie, no x-datadome/x-dd-b header. The vendor gate must reject it. FP guard.
